servinfo.title: Front and Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Encoder Inspection

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Wheel Speed Sensor Encoder Removal and Installation
Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Encoder Removal and Installation

attention3.ptxt: Wheel speed sensor encoder is included in wheel hub assembly. If wheel speed sensor encoder needs to be replaced, replace wheel hub assembly.

servinfo.ptxt: Check front and rear wheel speed sensor encoders for crack, damage, or deformation.
Replace wheel hub assembly if defective.
